title: Remanufactured TreadClimbers for Sale
descriptionHtml:
Experience joint-friendly, high-efficiency cardio with Bowflex TreadClimbers—a 3-in-1 motion that blends treadmill, stepper, and elliptical into a compact footprint. At Fitness Superstore, our remanufactured units go through teardown, part replacement, refinishing, and full testing for like-new performance at a fraction of MSRP.

We carry legacy Bowflex TreadClimber models including TC1000, TC3000, TC5000, TC10, TC5300, TC5500, TC6000, and TC20. Looking for commercial durability? See the StairMaster TC5 and Star Trac E-TC.

View the TreadClimber comparison chart to pick the right model.

node.value: Shop Treadclimbers, Bowflex TC5000, TC1000, Remanufactured at Fitness Superstore. Browse equipment options for home, studio, and commercial fitness spaces.

Why Choose a TreadClimber?

  • Efficient calorie burn: The hybrid stepping + walking path delivers more output at lower speeds.
  • Low-impact training: Joint-friendly motion is ideal for long sessions and rehab-minded users.
  • Compact footprint: Fits where separate stepper + treadmill + elliptical won’t.
  • Commercial-grade options: Rugged alternatives are available (see below).

Bowflex TreadClimber Models We Carry

  • TC1000 — Entry model with simplified electronics and compact frame.
  • TC3000 — Mid-range with adjustable intensity and reliable hybrid motion.
  • TC10 — Powered console with speed, time, distance, and calories tracking.
  • TC5000 — Durable frame; select units include climb indicator and HR strap support.
  • TC5300 — Larger platform with smoother stride; up to ~4.5 mph.
  • TC5500 — Premium model with ~15 programs, goal coaching, and 4-user profiles.
  • TC6000 — Advanced Bowflex Advantage console, ~18 readouts, and 5-user memory.
  • TC20 — High-tier home unit with built-in workouts and wireless HR compatibility.

Note: Bowflex discontinued these models, but remanufactured units appear periodically. See current stock above.

Commercial Alternatives

  • StairMaster TC5 — Hydraulics-free design with a “walking on sand” feel and heavy-use durability.
  • Star Trac E-TC — Split-deck path increases stride length and hip engagement for serious calorie burn.

FAQs About Bowflex TreadClimbers

Are Bowflex TreadClimbers discontinued?

Yes. All models that we sell are legacy, but remanufactured units are available via Fitness Superstore with warranty options.

Which models burn the most calories?

Higher-spec units (TC5300, TC5500, TC6000, TC20) support faster speeds and advanced programs that help sustain tougher sessions.

Do you offer delivery and installation?

Yes. We ship nationwide and offer white-glove installation (recommended for stairs/tight spaces).

What ceiling height do I need?

Because the motion raises user height, measure clearance above your tallest user. Contact us for model-specific guidance.

Do these units include a warranty?

Yes—coverage is shown on each product page. Extended options are available for additional peace of mind.

title: Woodway USA
descriptionHtml:
Experience the quality, comfort, and precision of remanufactured Woodway treadmills, the most trusted slat-belt machines in the fitness industry. Each treadmill is remanufactured in the USA, tested for accuracy, and restored to commercial standards to deliver the same smooth, low-impact performance as new models at 30–60% savings.

Built with Woodway’s patented slat-belt technology, these treadmills glide quietly on ball bearings to reduce impact, protect joints, and provide a natural running feel for athletes, rehabilitation clinics, and home training spaces. Every unit is backed by a 1-year parts and labor warranty, extendable up to 5 years, and supported by nationwide on-site service for peace of mind.

Whether you are upgrading a fitness center, outfitting a physical therapy clinic, or enhancing your home gym, Woodway treadmills offer the durability and performance trusted by professionals worldwide.

Shop remanufactured Woodway treadmills below and experience commercial reliability built for endurance, recovery, and long-term comfort.

Featured Models: Built for Performance, Comfort, and Endurance

Woodway treadmills are known for unmatched durability, comfort, and engineering precision. This collection includes motorized models for powerful, controlled running, manual curved treadmills for self-paced athletic performance, and compact options for smaller gyms and personal training spaces.

Every Woodway unit delivers quiet operation, minimal maintenance, and the signature slat-belt cushioning that supports smooth, joint-friendly movement.

Experience the perfect blend of power and precision. Woodway motorized treadmills deliver smooth, quiet performance designed for serious runners, rehab centers, and fitness facilities that demand lasting reliability.

Top pics

2. Woodway 4Front Treadmill w/Quick Set 2024 Display (Remanufactured)

A next-generation design featuring the Quick Set 2024 console for simplified workout control and real-time performance tracking. Ideal for professional facilities and athletes who value speed, feedback, and precision.

5. Woodway Desmo Evo Treadmill (Remanufactured)

Designed for rehabilitation and therapy use, the Desmo Evo features precise speed control and a cushioned deck to ensure safe, comfortable recovery sessions.

B. Woodway Manual Treadmills

Train naturally and push your limits. Woodway manual treadmills use curved, self-powered designs to enhance stride efficiency, calorie burn, and athletic performance, no electricity required.

Top pics

The Curve Trainer uses a self-powered curved design that adapts to your stride, encouraging natural running mechanics while burning more calories than standard treadmills. It’s ideal for sports training and HIIT workouts.

The EcoMill runs entirely on user power and produces zero energy waste. Its smooth slat-belt motion and durable build make it perfect for performance training and eco-conscious fitness facilities.

FAQs About Woodway Treadmills

1. How are remanufactured Woodway treadmills restored?

Each used Woodway treadmill is remanufactured in the USA by certified technicians. Every unit is disassembled, refinished, and reassembled with restored or new components, then tested for precision and durability before shipping.

2. What warranty comes with Woodway treadmills?

All remanufactured Woodway treadmills include a 1-year parts and labor warranty, with options to extend up to 5 years. Every warranty includes on-site service across the USA and Canada for complete peace of mind.

3. Can I finance my Woodway treadmill purchase?

Yes, flexible financing options are available to make your investment more affordable. Contact our sales team for details on current plans and promotions.

4. Do you offer delivery and installation?

We provide nationwide delivery and optional white-glove installation services, ensuring your treadmill is professionally assembled and ready for use.

Enduring Miles with Woodway

Built to last and designed for comfort, Woodway treadmills stand as a symbol of precision engineering and unmatched durability.

From professional facilities to home studios, they transform every run into a smoother, quieter, and more natural experience, helping you move better, recover faster, and train longer.
